text:
ella: Quick UX check — prototyped a 'midnight' dark heatmap for Console. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/example-midnight. Main issues: legend wording vague, tiny swatches disappear at 16px, inline code syntax feels washed. Screenshot attached.
rohan: I see that. The darkest stop almost matches the page bg. Two quick options: lift the darkest stop or add a 1px inner stroke to swatches/cells. Also prefer explicit numeric ranges in the legend (not 'low/med/high').
anya: Accessibility note: small legend text must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1). Current label color ~3.8:1 on #071018. Recommend #cbd8e6 or semibold weight. Also add non-color cues (dots/hatch) for the <5% bucket for colorblind users.
mike: Frontend constraints: avoid adding DOM nodes per cell. We can bake the inner stroke into the canvas paint pass and toggle a tiny dotted overlay only for export. CSS/code snippet for focus + code blocks:```
:root{--code-bg:#0f1113;--code-fg:#e8f3ff;--focus:#1f6feb}
.code {background:var(--code-bg);color:var(--code-fg)}
.heatmap-cell:focus{outline:3px solid var(--focus)}
```
a11y-bot: Auto-contrast-check: legend label #9fb0bd on bg #071018 => contrast 3.8:1 (small text fails). Suggested replacements: #cbd8e6 (contrast 5.2:1) or use semibold at 12px+. Also recommend including <title> and <desc> in exported SVGs and adding succinct alt text for PNGs (example: "Token frequency heatmap. Color scale: 0-5% (hatched), 6-20% (indigo), 21-60% (teal), >60% (cyan)").
ella: (typo) disregard.
ella: Plan: Mike will prototype canvas-outline + export pattern, Rohan will update legend copy to numeric ranges, Anya will validate contrast. Quick poll: outline (:+1:) or pattern (:-1:)?
